classification: IH2-066 non-executable resource/ingredient design experiment; no runtime changes
selected: reserve next craft / stop voluntary welcome requests after six / four-hour optional NPC orders
method: Independent mass-balanced crop ledger reuses current065 deadlines, seed quotas, held harvests and12-slot stacks. Candidate pine bank6,1/4h,24carried; free bound saw lesson assumed completed. Day0setup is included. Uniform known-strategy visits; one disclosed14–21dayabsence cohort. Claim/gather/harvest, optional firstsix easels, optional welcome requests stopped after six as a solo funded-goal proxy, spare-ingredient order, reharvest/replant. Finishing is independent of the existing ordinary bench. Models assume opt-in anonymous recording on each claim; players retain the item.
limits: Not actual game state, valid save, network authority, player preference or human enjoyment
No auto craft/order/harvest is proposed; greedy strategy stands for deliberate preview/confirm inputs

Selected versus legacy-first bundles reservation AND stopping voluntary welcome requests at six; do not attribute all differences to reservation alone. Runtime continues to allow personal requests; choosing them changes the candidate outcomes
Current GardenStatev1 cannot represent new ingredient sinks: implementation needs explicit versioned spent-by-use conservation, not forged request counts
No tool-lesson duration, travel, dialogue/quests, art action duration, modular gear, making/gardening XP or full housing/currency economy modeled
Public six-credit arithmetic is not concurrency/UUID/permission proof; server transactions still required
Several visits can remain quiet and finite goals saturate; this family does not certify a full evening of content
